content: ent/runtime exists to break the import cycle: schema package hooks/policy closures reference generated types (*ent.Tx etc), which would require importing the generated ent package, which itself is generated from the schema package - a cycle. ent generates an ent/runtime package that registers schema-level hooks/policies via side-effecting init() at runtime; caller imports ent/runtime once near client construction to activate registration. Two-pass bootstrap: generate once with stub/empty Hooks()/Policy(), then flesh out bodies that import generated types safely.
